   x - 3 = -8
   \]

   \[
   x = -8 + 3
   \]

   x = -5
   \]

grade.gold_answer: Multiplying both sides by $4x-4$ and by 3 gives $3(3x-1) = 2(4x-4)$.  Expanding the products on both sides gives $9x-3 = 8x - 8$.  Subtracting $8x$ from both sides $x -3 = -8$ and adding 3 to both sides gives $x = \boxed{-5}$.
